title: Wren and the Static
author: Silas Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Galloway, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
